meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
For oily and acne-prone skin, the ideal face wash should control excess sebum, clear out congested pores, and contain active ingredients like **Salicylic Acid (BHA)**, **Glycolic Acid (AHA)**, or **Niacinamide**—all without completely stripping your skin's natural moisture barrier.[www.flipkart.com](https://www.flipkart.com/beauty-and-grooming/body-face-skin-care/body-and-face-care/face-wash/pr?sid=g9b,ema,5la,jav#:~:text=More%20about%20Face%20Wash%20%2B%20Related%20Searches.,%2CElement%20Face%20Wash%20%2Clabolia%20Face%20Wash%20%2CAstaberry)

The top-rated face washes available in India under ₹500 categorized by skin concerns include:

### 1. Best for Deep Pore Cleansing & Acne Control: Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Cleanser

* **Price:** Approx. ₹299 (100ml)
* **Key Ingredients:** 2% Salicylic Acid, LHA, Zinc[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/face-wash-under-500#:~:text=Simple%20Kind%20to%20Skin%20Refreshing%20Facewash%20Mild,Skin.%20%E2%82%B9299%E2%82%B926910%25%20Off.%20Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B929.)
* **Why buy it:** It is a cult-favorite active-based cleanser designed specifically for oily, acne-prone skin.[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/face-wash-under-500#:~:text=Minimalist%202%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20%2B%20LHA%20Face,dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B929.%20Enjoy%20Complimentary%20Gift.%20%28141398%29.) Salicylic acid dives deep into pores to dissolve trapped sebum and dead skin cells, while Zinc helps regulate overall oil production.

### 2. Best Gel Cleanser for Daily Oil Control: Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash

* **Price:** Approx. ₹345 to ₹380 (120ml)[nourishmantra.in](https://nourishmantra.in/blogs/news/best-cleanser-for-face-in-india#:~:text=Rating%3A%209%2F10.%20Price%3A%20%E2%82%B9495.%20Buy%20Here.%20Why,glycolic%20acid%20%3D%20perfect%20for%20acne-prone%20skin.)
* **Key Ingredients:** Green Tea Extracts, Glycolic Acid[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/face-wash-under-500#:~:text=The%20Derma%20Co.%20Sali-Cinamide%20Anti-Acne%20Face%20Wash,Cleanses%20%26%20Brightens%20Skin.%20All%20Skin%20Type.)
* **Why buy it:** A gentle, non-drying gel that features gentle chemical exfoliation via glycolic acid.[blog.flash.co](https://blog.flash.co/face-wash/top-25-face-washes-for-oily-skin/#:~:text=See%20on%20Flash.%20At%20%E2%82%B9175%20with%205%2C361,and%20refreshing%2C%20well%20suited%20for%20humid%20conditions.) The green tea provides antioxidants to soothe inflammation and active pimples, making it refreshing for daily use in humid weather.[blog.flash.co](https://blog.flash.co/face-wash/top-25-face-washes-for-oily-skin/#:~:text=Plum%20Green%20Tea%20Pore%20Cleansing%20Face%20Wash,the%20cheapest%20top-ranked%20products%20in%20the%20list.)

### 3. Best Budget Foaming Option: Pilgrim Tea Tree Purifying Foaming Face Wash

* **Price:** Approx. ₹175 to ₹250
* **Key Ingredients:** Tea Tree, Salicylic Acid[blog.flash.co](https://blog.flash.co/face-wash/top-25-face-washes-for-oily-skin/#:~:text=1.%20Pilgrim%20Tea%20Tree%20Purifying%20Foaming%20Face,93%2F100.%20%E2%82%B9175.%20%E2%86%93%202.%20The%20Derma%20Co.)
* **Why buy it:** Highly rated for its deep-cleansing foam action, this budget-friendly pick tackles stubborn grease and controls acne breakouts effectively without leaving a heavy residue.[blog.flash.co](https://blog.flash.co/face-wash/top-25-face-washes-for-oily-skin/#:~:text=1.%20Pilgrim%20Tea%20Tree%20Purifying%20Foaming%20Face,93%2F100.%20%E2%82%B9175.%20%E2%86%93%202.%20The%20Derma%20Co.)

### 4. Best Gentle Option for Oily yet Sensitive Skin: Deconstruct Salicylic Acid & Niacinamide Oil Control Face Wash

* **Price:** Approx. ₹299 (100ml)[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/face-wash-under-500#:~:text=Enjoy%20Free%20Gift.%20Deconstruct.%20Salicylic%20Acid%20%26,For%20Reducing%20Sebum%20%26%20Acne.%202%20Sizes.)
* **Key Ingredients:** Salicylic Acid, Niacinamide[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/dp/face-wash-under-500#:~:text=Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B938.%20Simple.%20Kind%20to,Skin.%20%E2%82%B9395%E2%82%B932019%25%20Off.%20Enjoy%20Free%20Gift.%20CeraVe.)
* **Why buy it:** If harsh acne cleansers usually irritate your skin, this combination works brilliantly. Salicylic acid clears the pores, while Niacinamide soothes redness, controls sebum, and repairs the skin barrier.

---

### Quick Buying Tips for Oily Skin:

* **Texture Check:** Prioritize **gels** or **lightweight foaming cleansers** over thick cream-based washes.
* **Avoid Over-Washing:** Even though your skin feels greasy, washing your face more than twice a day can trick your skin into producing *more* oil to compensate for the dryness.
